leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a custom usePrevious hook from scratch
Apply the usePrevious hook to track previous state values in functional components
Configure the hook to handle different data types (strings, numbers, objects)
Initialize and update the previous value reference within the hook's logic
Integrate the usePrevious hook with useState to compare current and previous values
Render component output that displays both current and previous values
Manipulate component state to observe the hook's tracking behavior in real-time
